title: The Rejuvenation Mirage: Identifiability Limits of Epigenetic-Clock Reset and an Active-Design Rule for Functional Repair

creators.name: Debnath, Devanik
creators.affiliation: National Institute of Technology Agartala, Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, India

description: Theoretical and synthetic-computational preprint formalizing an identifiability limit between direct epigenetic-clock marker effects and latent functional repair. Includes a deterministic synthetic benchmark and constrained information-gain design planner. No biological dataset, wet-lab experiment, clinical intervention, or organismal lifespan assay was performed. This metadata is prepared for possible future deposit only; no DOI is claimed or minted.
